templates.source_expression:
f"FINAL TURN. You have used your {limit} model calls for this unit, and every tool "
        "except the outcome report has been withdrawn — no further Read, Grep, execute or "
        "graph call will run.\n\n"
        "Report the outcome object NOW from the evidence you already hold. Findings you have "
        "confirmed are kept; do not discard them because you wanted one more lookup. If a "
        "question stayed open, say so in the rationale and set the verdict accordingly — "
        "`inconclusive` is honest, silence is not."
